Andrew Garfield expresses fear of backlash over Sam Altman role

Actor Andrew Garfield stated he is 'really scared' of potential backlash regarding his portrayal of OpenAI founder Sam Altman in a new film. The Independent reported on Garfield's apprehension. The Daily Telegraph also covered Garfield's comments, noting his hope that his new film would 'terrify billionaires'.
